userStories.title: Trial enforcement at the LLM key-resolution choke point
userStories.description: FIRST, document ground truth in the commit body: grep the credential-resolution seam (search PLATFORM_KEY_WORKSPACE_ID — the #610 workspace-key-first resolver) and record how a keyless workspace resolves TODAY (unbounded platform-key fallback vs error). THEN add `def resolve_trial_routing(` (new orchestrator/services/trial_ledger.py, called from that single seam): (1) workspace has its own working key → use it, zero trial involvement; (2) else trial state active/warned → route to the platform key, force/validate the requested model against TRIAL_MODEL_ALLOWLIST (off-list request → allowlisted model substituted or clear typed error — pick ONE behavior and test it), and accumulate spent_usd per request using the platform's EXISTING per-request cost/usage computation (grep the usage-tracking write path; reuse its pricing, do not build a second pricing table); at spent>=80% flip state to warned; at >=100% flip to exhausted; (3) else → the existing no-key error path unchanged. Exhausted requests return a TYPED error (stable error code, e.g. trial_exhausted) the frontend can render deterministically. Daily global counter: accumulate today's trial spend in the existing system_settings plane (key like trial_spend_YYYY-MM-DD); US-004's grant reads it. No-background-burn: the heartbeat/scheduled execution path (grep scheduled_task_service + heartbeat runner) SKIPS workspaces whose onboarding.trial.state is active/warned/exhausted, recording a visible skip reason — never a silent no-op. A validated key save flips state to converted (hook in US-006).

userStories.title: OnboardingSection v2 — the stage-aware conversational spine
userStories.description: Rework orchestrator/modules/context/sections/onboarding.py (~:25-150, re-verify): trigger = the workspace's onboarding.stage NOT IN (completed, skipped) — replacing the agent_count==0 heuristic — plus the existing manual re-trigger phrases; returns '' otherwise. Stage-aware content tells Auto exactly where the user is and what happens next: questions (the 3 questions, one at a time, conversational) → teach (offer platform_scan_business_site / doc upload / just talk; play back and correct) → proposal (plan + starter team card, explicit yes required) → building → boom (invite a question about THEIR business) → powerup (the OpenRouter recommendation copy: one key, pay-as-you-go, 400+ models; other providers collapsed; trial balance mentioned) → checklist framing. Section content must direct Auto to record every advance via platform_update_onboarding (never assume), to adapt register to segment.comfort, to consult the capability report (skip scan gracefully when firecrawl_configured=false), and must NEVER instruct mission creation with auto_approve or skip_verification. Include the direct-vs-mission threshold: <=3 agents and <=2 Playbooks → direct tool calls after the explicit yes; larger → a normal mission (default awaiting_approval).
